scope: Fixed exploratory comparison. Labels written by the implementation author, not independently adjudicated. New means not used in the prior 12-case run; not a blinded external benchmark.
hypothesis: An attribution gate reduces mistaken pausing/resuming from reports, hypotheticals and output instructions without dropping current self intentions.

releaseGate.scope: Passing is necessary for further sandbox testing only, not production approval.
